reasoning: Work is in flight — the implementation under way counts the image pairs the package ships. The demand to stop counting them changes the constraints of that running work, so it is a correction: 'A correction attaches to work, not to a queue. When a message changes something already in flight, find that work and change it.' The clause 'убери этот дебилизм' is the repair stated aloud, which the skill assigns to the correction itself: 'The first is the repair stated aloud — do it this way instead, sweep it as a class, take that part out. That clause names what the replan will contain, so it is the correction's own goal in other words'; naming it as an instruction of its own would re-open as fresh work the very thing the correction just changed. The closing sentence — any pair of pictures in the world must get a transition built for it — is not merely the correction's grounds, because 'Grounds stated with an act carry their own act only when they say something new'; it states what the project must do from here on, and 'A clause saying what the project will do from here on — the rule, the grant of authority, the division of responsibility — is a decision.' It rides alongside the correction but is recorded separately so the rule survives after that work item closes. 'в 1000000 раз говорю' does not make it a new idea and is not a separate act: 'Reminding that a goal already in the plan still stands is the same kind of act — a decision reaffirmed, not a new idea.' The insult and the exasperation report nothing new — 'A message is conversation when it adds nothing, not when it is said lightly.' Neither act creates work: 'Replanning is what a correction asks for, and replanning takes on nothing that did not already exist: the board gains no row, and the count of new pieces of work the turn produces is zero. The same holds for a decision applied to running work.' Hence work_items 0, creates_work false, attaches_to_existing_work true, and the operation is the state change on the ticket already in flight. Dimensions are named because 'The one exception is a correction, which changes work already running: saying what that work now touches is the whole point of it' — the corrected work changes product behaviour (the engine must build a transition for any pair, not for a counted set), the data and operations that carried the pair counting, and the regressions guarding the removal. Specialists follow that: spec author because 'behaviour changes beyond what the spec already says' — the standing rule is a behaviour law and needs its one declared home; developer because the counting must be taken out; test author because the evidence and regressions for the removed measurement must be rechosen. No architect, prover, publisher or communicator: nothing about boundaries, class-defect hunting or shipping was asked for, and 'Naming a dimension claims something in it must change; if nothing in it changes, do not name it.'
